name: ImageAndText
description: Display some featured text alongside an image.

contentAlign.description: The horizontal alignment of the content within the available space.

contentMaxWidth.description: The maximum width of the content as a percentage of the available space; may be ignored in small viewports/containers.

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant). Note: For components that use the BEM trait, this must be set before init_bem_classes() is called for class naming to work as expected.

imageAlign.description: The horizontal alignment of the image within the available space.

imageFirst.description: Whether the image should be rendered first in the HTML.

imageMaxWidth.description: The maximum width of the image as a percentage of the available space; may be ignored in small viewports/containers.

overlayAmount.description: The amount in pixels to overlay the content over the image.

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set. If explicitly set, handling is component-specific depending on CSS requirements: some will use it in place of generic defaults, others will add a wrapper or adjust BEM classes but otherwise keep the same HTML structure.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: An Image component, plus one or more other components to be rendered in the content area.
